1.name: Cody Rhodes
1.notes: Undisputed WWE Champ. Retained vs Orton at WM42 — Telemachus holds across WM40 coronation, WM41 defense, WM42 defense. Three consecutive Manias. Jelly Roll/McAfee circus mid-match; Cody smiled through it. Telemachus doesn't need the circus.

2.name: CM Punk
2.notes: Promethean: stole fire (kayfabe truth), paid in blood, returned. WM42 vs Reigns = two eras litigating.

3.name: Roman Reigns
3.aspect: WWE Champion; WM42 main event winner
3.notes: **WM42: defeated Punk clean in the main event.** Alchemical reciprocity resolved through combat — the mutual confession ("I hate you because I envy you") became prophecy. Post-match: walked past panel to stage edge, one finger up. Crowd chant transitioned "Roman Reigns" → "OTC" (man → crown). The king who doesn't need to prove he's king. Tier upgraded from Transitional to Pantheon.

4.name: Jey Uso
4.notes: Won WHC at WM41, lost it back to Gunther. Reunited with Jimmy. Icarian fall-and-return now live text.

6.name: Solo Sikoa
6.aspect: former MFT leader; chief without a faction
6.notes: Renamed Bloodline to MFTs (July 2025). **SmackDown 4/25/26**: Lost clean to Fatu. Tama grabbed the mic from him (internal coup). Fatu destroyed the whole faction. The usurper-king's army dissolved in one episode. Macbeth after Birnam Wood arrives. Approaching Royce Keys post-show — trying to reassert dominance over a newcomer = the dethroned chief grasping for any subject.

7.name: Jacob Fatu
7.notes: **WM42: defeated Drew McIntyre in unsanctioned match.** Aitu confirmed. **SmackDown 4/25/26**: Full-circle arc in one episode — opened questioning himself ("you're not ready"), superkicked Tama (rejection), beat Solo clean (hierarchy overturned), destroyed the entire MFT faction post-match, then declared for Raw: "I see y'all on Raw." The aitu walked through the chief-usurper to get to the real target. Roman collision has full legitimacy. Free agent crossing brands by declaration, not draft.

8.name: Tama Tonga
8.notes: Defected from Solo April 13. **SmackDown 4/25/26**: Grabbed the mic from Solo (internal coup), then got superkicked by Fatu. Caught between two forces — rejected the chief, then rejected by the aitu. Archetype forming: the lieutenant who tried to seize the voice and got silenced from both sides.

10.name: JC Mateo
10.notes: Formerly Hikuleo. Outsider-initiate completing the war-party structure.

11.name: Damian Priest
11.notes: Scroll 001. NOT a psychopomp — doesn't ferry souls or manage the threshold. Anubis stands at the scale with the feather of Ma'at and determines whether your heart is worthy. Not rage-coded (Erinyes pursue and punish); Priest is measured, disciplined, procedural. "Judgment Day" = the Egyptian weighing of the heart. He doesn't chase — he weighs and renders the verdict. WWE Tag Champ with R-Truth ("Wepa Up").

12.name: Finn Bálor
12.aspect: Demon Bálor; WM42 street fight winner
12.notes: **WM42: defeated Dominik in street fight.** Demon reclaimed. NOT a death figure — a primordial chaos force. Fomorians are the Celtic Titans: the race that existed before the gods, analogous to Greek Titans, Norse Jötnar. Balor's Evil Eye = annihilation gaze, not psychopomp. Crawling entrance = pre-human regression. Paint = protean chaos-form. Coup de Grâce = the Eye directed downward. Expulsion from Judgment Day is mythologically inevitable: chaos cannot govern (cf. Bres's failed Fomorian kingship). Three-stage arc: primordial force → miscast in ordered stable → reclaimed as what it always was.

13.name: Dominik Mysterio
13.notes: First simultaneous WWE/AAA champion. **WM42: lost to Demon Bálor in street fight.** Betrayer-son on WWE side; Tezcatlipoca (Smoking Mirror / betrayer-deceiver) on AAA side — the obsidian mirror showing AAA what it became under WWE ownership. Dom-vs-Vikingo = Tezcatlipoca-vs-Quetzalcoatl axis (booking enacting Aztec source-text). Cross-ref: AAA — Roster.

14.name: JD McDonagh
14.notes: Ousted Finn — gives him a heel story now.

15.name: Seth Rollins
15.notes: **WM42: lost to Gunther via Bron Breakker interference.** Breakker walked up ramp to Heyman — puppetmaster has a new enforcer. The system protected its devourer. BROKEN ritual (Night 1). Edda's bound-Loki: founder-of-monster, expelled, unbound.

16.name: Drew McIntyre
16.notes: Held WWE Title Jan 9 – Mar 6. Fatu interference across both ends. WM42 unsanctioned. Embittered old-god writing.

17.name: Gunther
17.notes: Retired Goldberg, Cena, AJ Styles (RR '26). "Career Killer" = Cronus-eating-children made literal. Wagnerian pedigree (Austrian). **WM42: retained WHC vs Rollins (Breakker interference).** The old order protected by its new enforcer.

18.name: Bron Breakker
18.notes: Cleared April. **WM42: interfered in Rollins/Gunther, walked up ramp to Heyman.** Puppetmaster has a new weapon. Ares-that-Kross-couldn't-land candidate.

20.name: Randy Orton
20.notes: **WM42: lost to Cody, then punted his orbital bone — the loser left more dangerous than the winner.** Apophis = Egyptian chaos serpent that attacks Ra every night. Ra defeats Apophis. Apophis returns. Every night. Forever. Orton's entire career is this cycle: you beat him, he bites you anyway. "Voices in My Head" = the serpent speaking through the vessel, not a choice but a nature. Legend Killer origin = destroying the old order. The Punt = not a wrestling move, a weapon that removes people from the story. Cody (solar king/Telemachus) NEEDS Apophis — the king who is never tested isn't a king, he's an heir with a warm seat. Not Jörmungandr (world-ending, too final) — Apophis is cyclical, eternal return, the nightly adversary that defines the solar journey by opposing it. **Title trajectory**: 14-time world champion. Cena and Flair both at 16. Three more reigns to break the record outright at 17. Roman's legacy was length (longest reign); Orton's will be frequency (most times crowned). The WM42 storyline isn't over — the punt accelerates the path to the title. Cody out 4-6 weeks with orbital fracture; the Serpent either takes the vacated crown or is holding it when the solar king returns. Either way: Ra rises at dawn, Apophis is waiting. The cycle IS the story.

21.name: LA Knight
21.notes: WM42 six-man w/ Usos vs Paul/Theory/iShowSpeed.

23.name: Sami Zayn
23.notes: Won US Title from Hayes March 27. Lost to Trick Williams clean at WM42. **SmackDown 4/25/26**: Hid inside a gingerbread mascot costume and ambushed Trick Williams. The predecessor who can't accept succession used the Sacred Clown's comedy register as a Trojan horse. Not a heel turn — a DESCENT. The man who always did it the right way is breaking. Watch: does the descent deepen or does he catch himself?

24.name: Trick Williams
24.notes: Won US Title from Sami clean at WM42. Crowd chanted "You deserve it." Pre-Mania read was Corrupted-Demihero — the crowd overruled it. Clean Demihero, generational succession confirmed.

25.name: Shinsuke Nakamura
25.notes: Emotional farewell match w/ AJ Jan 24.

29.name: R-Truth
29.aspect: WWE Tag Champ w/ Priest ("Wepa Up")
29.notes: **Hall of Two Truths**: Priest (Anubis) + R-Truth (Thoth) = complete Egyptian judgment apparatus. Thoth = the recorder of truth, trickster-wisdom. Doesn't understand the verdict intellectually — just IS where it needs to be witnessed. "R-Truth" as a ring name IS the Thoth function. The Fool-to-Death Tarot pairing deepens: Fool (0) walks with Death (XIII), but Thoth RECORDS the judgment Anubis renders. Upgraded from pure-trickster to Trickster-Pantheon.

32.name: Joe Hendry
32.aspect: Raw; called up 4/20 Raw After Mania
32.notes: Called up from NXT to Raw on Raw After Mania (4/20/26). Crowd chants him into existence. Orphic — singing brings believers back. "I believe" = congregation, not catchphrase. Lost NXT title to D'Angelo at S&D, graduated immediately after. Concert segment scheduled for Raw 4/28. Cross-ref: TNA Departed — Hendry was TNA's archetypal center (NXT-partnership era) before the call-up.

33.name: Penta
33.notes: **Retained IC title at WM42 ladder match.** Mesoamerican archetype.

36.name: Logan Paul
36.aspect: World Tag Champ w/ Theory; Vision

38.name: Brock Lesnar
38.aspect: WM42: lost to Oba Femi, retired
38.notes: **Integrated at WM42.** Every indicator present: defeated cleanly by generational successor, tears, "Thank you Brock" chants, boots + gloves left in ring, Heyman embrace, Oba's respectful tip of the cap. Surtr integrated, not hibernating. The devourer wept and walked away. Canonical example of integration departure mode. Vessel-stability caveat remains for any scroll treatment.

39.name: Oba Femi
39.notes: **WM42: defeated Lesnar decisively.** Streak-seed identified — the man who ended the Undertaker's 21-0 becomes the first sacrifice to the new streak. Crowd chanted OTC during post-match. Asserted eyes-to-camera that OTC could come get it — WM43 seed planted by the crowd, not creative. Tier upgraded from Pantheon-adj to full Pantheon. Specific orisha still TBD — do not pick without performer-content grounding.

40.name: Pat McAfee
40.notes: Commentator as on-screen storyline driver. Operates across the kayfabe/shoot line.

41.name: iShowSpeed
41.notes: Guest vessel for The Vision. Streamer in the kayfabe/reality crack.

42.name: Nikki Cross
42.notes: Left WWE (confirmed 4/25/26). Wyatt Sicks feminine seat (seer/maenad) now MOOT — full faction dissolved 2026-04-24. SAnitY-era maenad archetype hibernated through her, re-attached to Wyatt Sicks, now departed with the unit.

43.name: Kairi Sane
43.notes: Yuki-onna vessel departed in post-WM42 purge. Lost Women's Tag titles January; mid-storyline release. Kabuki Warriors paired-apparition structure with Asuka now broken — Yuki-onna seat unheld.

44.name: Alba Fyre
44.notes: Brigid-corrupted vessel departed. Secret Hervice loses its active champion — Green (injured) and Niven (injured) leave the faction unmoored. Forge-fire-goddess seat unheld.

45.name: Zelina Vega
45.notes: Released alongside husband Aleister Black. Former US Champion. Valkyrie-of-the-small seat unheld. The "Necessary Evil" pairing departs as a unit — note structural rhyme with Wyatt Sicks unit-departure on the same day.

46.name: Zoey Stark
46.notes: Recently cleared from year-long knee injury; released before reactivation. Archetype was forming pre-injury; never landed at main-roster scale.

47.name: AJ Styles
47.notes: Lost career match to Gunther at Royal Rumble '26. Move to historical.

48.name: Karrion Kross
48.notes: Final Testament disbanded Feb 2025. Failed-Ares scroll still valid as post-mortem case study.

49.name: Bobby Lashley
49.notes: Signed 2-year AEW deal Oct 2024 (not Feb 2026 as previously noted). Hurt Syndicate (Lashley + Benjamin + MVP). Cross-ref: AEW — Men.

50.name: Bo Dallas (Uncle Howdy)
50.notes: Wyatt Sicks hierophant. Returned to WWE 2024 specifically to launch the faction as ritual tribute to late brother Bray Wyatt. The grief work was the gimmick. **Released as part of the unit** — see Wyatt Sicks faction entry for Joe's collective-return read.

51.name: Erick Rowan
51.notes: Last living original Wyatt Family member. "Ramblin' Rabbit" within Sicks. Released as part of the unit.

52.name: Joe Gacy
52.notes: Wyatt Sicks zealot; former tag champ. Released as part of the unit.

53.name: Dexter Lumis
53.notes: Wyatt Sicks threshold-keeper; former tag champ. Second WWE release. Released as part of the unit.

54.name: Aleister Black
54.notes: Returned April 2025. Occult-adept / dark-monk vessel departed in post-WM42 purge. Released alongside Zelina Vega. Wyatt Sicks scroll-pairing candidate now moot — but archetype-wise this means TWO occult-adept vessels (Black + entire Sicks) departed within 24 hours of each other. Significant drain on chthonic-occult register simultaneously.

55.name: Alex Shelley (MCMG)
55.notes: Brief WWE tenure after tag championship win. Indie-veteran tag-team archetype unheld at main-roster level.

56.name: Chris Sabin (MCMG)
56.notes: Released with tag partner Shelley. Same tag-team unit-departure pattern.

57.name: Santos Escobar
57.notes: Multiple injuries limited his appearances. LWO already eroded; this confirms the faction is unrecoverable in current form.

58.name: Apollo Crews
58.notes: 13-year veteran; absent from major storylines. Vessel never fully landed at main-roster scale across multiple gimmick attempts.

59.name: Rhea Ripley
59.notes: Scroll 001 + future Morrigan scroll. Macha = sovereignty + warrior-queen. Hel-adjacent (half-beautiful, half-decayed). Part of Morrigan triple-split with Valkyria.

60.name: Liv Morgan
60.notes: **WM42: defeated Vaquer for Women's World Championship.** Inanna descent-and-return COMPLETE. Arc literal: dislocated shoulder → 5-month absence → Survivor Series return → Royal Rumble win → WM42 title reclamation. Scroll 003 frame locked: the return is the scroll. Lilith = JD collective reading; Morgan individually = Inanna. Two scales.

61.name: Stephanie Vaquer
61.notes: Former Women's World Champion (lost to Liv Morgan at WM42). "Devil's Kiss" = crossroads-pact signifier. First simultaneous CMLL double-champion (two-gate symbology). Andean import; Hekate has syncretized with Andean goddesses in folk-Catholic practice.

62.name: Jade Cargill
62.notes: Storm/X-Men is the pop-culture surface; Oya is the underlying mythic figure. Sky/storm/weather-coded, not underworld. 9-aspect canon makes multi-vessel carry on-mythology — cleanest bifurcation test case. Currently leading Michin + B-Fab as attendant-priestesses.

63.name: Bianca Belair
63.notes: Oshun over Neith's loom. "EST" = Oshun's mirror — names herself before the world can. Braid-as-whip = Neith's weaving domain. WM37 = Oshun's origin (dismissed then indispensable). Pregnancy announced WM42 Night 1 = archetype deepening, not breaking — Oshun is a fertility deity whose power channels through motherhood. Part of Black Feminine Sovereignty Relay (Bianca→Mercedes→Naomi).

64.name: IYO SKY
64.archetype: The Bride Who Became the Queen
64.aspect: the one whose house broke and who climbs alone
64.notes: Betrayed by Asuka Sep 2025; lost Ripley partnership Feb 2026. Structural descent-and-return at Pantheon scale. Specific Japanese-goddess name TBD — structural label is the honest read until specialist confirms the right goddess.

65.name: Asuka
65.aspect: vengeful ghost; blue/green mist as curse-signifier
65.notes: Heel run since Sep 2025 — sprays mist, turns on IYO. This IS the onryō pattern: wronged one who returns to poison and drown. ~~Kairi Sane pairs as Yuki-onna attendant~~ (Sane RELEASED 2026-04-24 — Onryō stands alone).

66.name: Lyra Valkyria
66.notes: Self-declared Morrigan vessel in shoot interviews. Crow imagery = Badb (battle-crow). Second Morrigan carrier alongside Ripley — triple-goddess split, not competitor.

67.name: Bayley
67.aspect: the one who holds another up
67.notes: Tag-teaming with Valkyria, helping her to WrestleMania. Service-archetype when examined honestly. Not "complicated."

68.name: Tiffany Stratton
68.notes: 302-day prior championship reign. **SmackDown 4/25/26**: Won Women's US Title from Giulia clean. Pre-match energy: happy Hogan/Papa Pump, kissed bicep — confident, not delusional. Knew she had it but came to work for it. Xochiquetzal (Mesoamerican: flowers, fertility, war's erotic consequence) — not "blonde-brassy-entitled." Her own words: wants "something layered." Clean win = earned, not stolen. Watch: does the new reign show the depth she asked for?

69.name: Nia Jax
69.notes: Not "Titaness" — Greek default for a Samoan-Tongan-Australian performer. Pele = heritage-respectful, character-accurate. Tag champ with Lash Legend (Irresistible Forces).

70.name: Lash Legend
70.notes: Irresistible Forces tag partner with Jax. Too early for solo read.

71.name: Becky Lynch
71.aspect: divine retribution; levelling force; Women's IC Champion
71.notes: Heel turn late 2025. Current arc = Nemesis — resents anyone standing higher. Prior "The Man" = Athena-as-usurper. Two distinct archetypes across career = Pantheon-level vessel work. **WM42: defeated AJ Lee, won Women's IC Title for record 3rd time.** 5 WM wins = new women's record. Post-WM42: publicly called shot at Undertaker's WM streak (25 wins). Likely bluster (would need 20+ more undefeated WMs), but the call itself is a booking signal — the institution is positioning her as legacy-tier. Nemesis claiming immortality tracks.

72.name: AJ Lee
72.notes: Returned Feb 2026 after 11-year absence. Women's IC Champion. Not kidnapped — queen. She chose to come back. Parallel with Paige's return at same WM42.

73.name: Raquel Rodriguez
73.aspect: warrior invoked when others can't handle the threat
73.notes: Judgment Day member. Literally "sent" in multi-person matches. Durga-as-tool subplot: tension with Morgan over title picture = Durga resenting being a tool.

74.name: Roxanne Perez
74.aspect: gifted one being shaped by the court

75.name: Chelsea Green
75.notes: Secret Hervice = Baba Yaga's chicken-legged house. Recruits, punishes, ambiguously helps. Injured (ankle) but still on TV running faction.

76.name: Piper Niven
76.notes: Secret Hervice enforcer. Out with neck injury. Hold until return.

77.name: Giulia
77.notes: Former Women's US Champion (two-time). Half-Japanese, half-Italian — dual cultural heritage = dual archetypal streams (Shinto/yokai + Roman/Catholic/Commedia). Unique syncretic potential on the roster. Stardom-pedigreed. THIS is Athena — strategos, not Cargill. **SmackDown 4/25/26**: Lost Women's US Title to Tiffany Stratton clean. Kiana James attempted interference (failed). The city-goddess lost her city. Watch: how does Athena respond to losing the crown while her attendant is actively undermining her?

78.name: Kiana James
78.notes: Giulia's manager. **SmackDown 4/25/26**: Acknowledged tension with Giulia but claimed "it lit a fire *within us*" — shared purpose. Then blamed Kathy Kelley for the tension she's causing. Classic manipulation grammar: blame the third party, stay close to the title. Failed interference in Giulia/Stratton match — showed her hand. **PREDICTION (logged 4/25/26)**: Turns on Giulia within two months.

79.name: Maxxine Dupri
79.notes: Betrayed by Natalya Jan 2026. Running vengeance arc.

80.name: Natalya
80.aspect: elder who turned on her student at 43
80.notes: Hart Foundation genealogical-memory. Heel turn betraying Maxxine. Hag archetype reached for — needs more TV evidence before fully committing the crone frame.

81.name: Michin
81.notes: Aligned with Cargill (March 2026). Attack-dog for the storm-queen.

82.name: B-Fab
82.notes: Same as Michin. Two attendant-priestesses under Cargill.

84.name: Alexa Bliss
84.notes: Tag with Charlotte Flair. Was Fiend's consort. Carries "the one who can be possessed." Sister-Abigail prediction shelved post-Sicks-dissolution (2026-04-24) — see Sister Abigail entry in Dormant section. The medium remains; the ritual it was being asked to complete is now deferred to an unknown future formation.

85.name: Charlotte Flair
85.notes: Returned Royal Rumble 2026. Ric's daughter, 14-time champion.

86.name: Jordynne Grace
86.notes: SmackDown roster (via TNA → NXT pipeline). Former TNA Knockouts World Champion. MOTY run with Masha Slamovich 2024-25. Skadi-warrior = the martial face of the giantess-huntress archetype. Three Skadi-carriers now distributed: Grace-warrior (WWE), Statlander-quiet (AEW), Kross-young (AEW). Cross-ref: TNA Departed.

87.name: Naomi
87.notes: Held Women's World Championship Aug 2025. Relinquished via pregnancy. Return projected late 2026 / early 2027.

88.name: Paige
88.aspect: stripped at seven gates (injury, leaked content, substance, narrative, retirement, exile, name), returned in underworld regalia
88.notes: WM42 surprise return replacing injured Nikki Bella — won Women's Tag Championship with Brie. Seven-gate stripping: neck injury, leaked intimate content, substance struggles, public narrative rewritten as cautionary tale, medical retirement, departure from WWE, name taken ("Saraya" in AEW). New blue/black/gold palette = lapis lazuli sovereignty, underworld retained not shed. Anti-Diva (Artemis-refusal) was pre-descent form; Inanna is post-descent. Distinct from AJ Lee/Persephone: AJ left voluntarily and returned the same; Paige was publicly destroyed and returned transformed. NOT Persephone — Persephone is taken, Inanna descends.

89.name: Andre Chase
89.notes: Confirmed emotional departure; Chase U revived shortly before release. Wounded-teacher / Chiron-failed archetype departs the medium. The booking that kept breaking the archetype finally broke the vessel.

90.name: Dante Chen
90.notes: 147 televised matches over five years. Never landed an archetype at main-roster scale.

91.name: Tony D'Angelo
91.notes: Mafia gimmick = lord-of-his-own-underworld. Post-Family-collapse, leather-jacket phase. Strongest NXT male reading.

92.name: Myles Borne
92.notes: Sacrifice-to-uphold-order archetype. Orton mentored. Vessel forming.

94.name: Ethan Page
94.notes: Self-mythologizing. Narcissus-adjacent. Former NXT Champ + NA.

96.name: Lexis King
96.notes: Son of Brian Pillman. Heir-archetype done consciously.

97.name: Charlie Dempsey
97.notes: Same archetype as King — claimed inheritance.

98.name: Shawn Spears
98.notes: "Veteran who teaches youth how to cheat." Instructive-shadow.

99.name: Lola Vice
99.notes: Cuban-American, 5th dan TKD, ex-Bellator. Striker-kick as killing-tool. Afro-Cuban heritage opens Santería/Oya channel — possible Oya-aspect carrier alongside Cargill (bifurcation per 9-aspect canon).

100.name: Tatum Paxley
100.notes: Not "creepy doll girl" — Slavic Baba Yaga at younger age. Liminal feminine. NXT Women's at Halloween Havoc, regained NA at S&D.

101.name: Blake Monroe
101.notes: Ex-Mariah May (AEW Women's World Champ). "Glamour" = Gaelic *gramarye* (learned magic, enchantment). Fae-sorceress, not Aphrodite-predator. Likely main-roster call-up 2026.

102.name: Kendal Grey
102.notes: Amateur wrestling pedigree. Quiet, deep archetype. Will take 2–3 years to fully land.

103.name: Wren Sinclair
103.notes: "I am the main character, you're a side character." Eris inserts herself into narrative by personality-force.

105.name: Zaria
105.notes: Norse giantess / winter-hunter / wasteland-rider. Likely successor to Ripley-Morrigan lineage.

107.name: Arianna Grace
107.aspect: Birthright; nepo-betrayer; former TNA Knockouts Champ
107.notes: Won TNA Knockouts title at No Surrender by using father Santino's Cobra against Lee. Lost it back Apr 15. Daughter-who-betrays-the-father-by-using-his-weapon = canonical Elektra inversion. Cross-ref: TNA Knockouts.

109.name: Darby Allin
109.aspect: AEW World Champion; courts death and returns
109.notes: Won title 4/15/26 from MJF in 2:15 — fastest in AEW history — using MJF's own 2021 hold. Coffin Drop = liturgy. Face paint = death-mask. Not "underdog babyface" — the psychopomp who crosses between worlds and returns laughing.

110.name: MJF
110.notes: Lost title to Allin via clean pin. "Justice For MJF" tantrum = false prince who cannot survive a clean loss. Not Loki (not a creator of monsters) — Iago, whose poison is words. AEW's structural answer to Cody Rhodes: same generation, opposite path.

111.name: Jon Moxley
111.notes: Continental belt as chthonic prize — ferries challengers and leaves them broken. Not faction leader; cult-prophet. Lugh-vs-Crom throughline against Ospreay.

112.name: Kazuchika Okada
112.notes: "Rainmaker" = rain-and-storm domain. Susanoo (Shinto storm-god exiled from heaven) over Greek Zeus. International title + de facto Family leadership = exiled prince building his own court. Faces Takeshita at DON 5/24.

113.name: Swerve Strickland
113.aspect: former 2x World Champion; off TV filming WBD
113.notes: African-diasporic frame: Anansi (West African spider trickster) + Prometheus (fire to the disenfranchised). Vessel temporarily out; archetype intact.

114.name: Will Ospreay
114.aspect: returned 3/15 from neck surgery; chasing Moxley
114.notes: British Celtic frame — Lugh is the multi-skilled radiant god who returns to challenge the death-king. NOT Apollo — Lugh suffers real wounds. Neck injury and return-through-pain are the substance. United Empire reactivated to fight Death Riders.

115.name: "Hangman" Adam Page
115.aspect: banned from world title; on hiatus
115.notes: Lost Texas Death to MJF at Revolution 3/15; per stip, can never challenge for World Title again. Job-on-the-ash-heap — the righteous man whose suffering is an examination he never asked for. TK calls it "self-imposed" — leaves the door cracked.

116.name: Kenny Omega
116.notes: Japanese-coded: Cleaner persona, years in Japan. Ronin, not emperor. Lost to MJF via Dynamite Diamond Ring at Dynasty. The Elite reunited (Omega + Bucks).

117.name: Konosuke Takeshita
117.aspect: Don Callis Family; NJPW TV Champ; defying Okada
117.notes: Refused to apologize after Dynasty loss, signaled break. Callis dangling Okada's International Title at DON 5/24 = staged murder. The protégé who turns the knife.

118.name: Samoa Joe
118.aspect: The Opps boss; returned 4/22 from concussion
118.notes: Polynesian-Mexican-American heritage. The king of the territory, the founder-figure. The Opps = patriarch-and-orphans, not stable.

119.name: Hechicero
119.aspect: Don Callis Family; CMLL World Heavyweight Champ
119.notes: *Hechicero* = sorcerer. Mask, gestures, persona are nahual (Mesoamerican shape-shifter / shaman). NOT "witch-doctor." Heritage-grounded read. Won CMLL World Heavyweight from Claudio March 2026.

120.name: Mistico
120.aspect: Trios Champion; AEW/CMLL dual contract since 3/15
120.notes: The original Místico (Sin Cara line). The santo-archetype — the fighting saint. CMLL pedigree. JetSpeed trios.

121.name: Bandido
121.notes: Beat Jericho April 2025 in Mask vs Title. The masked angel who steals from rich heels. Brodido tag w/ Brody King.

122.name: Ricochet
122.notes: Hermes — the messenger who works for whoever pays. Beat Hurt Syndicate twice; first man to pin them in AEW. The Demand = debt-extraction crew, not chaos faction.

123.name: Brody King
123.aspect: World Title challenger; Hounds of Hell alpha
123.notes: DA-reconciled: individual chthonic-warrior, not collective Cerberus. Cerberus claim is trademark-filed, not on-screen earned. King solo carries the archetype; stable fragmented (Matthews injured, Hart seceded).

124.name: Kevin Knight
124.notes: Won vacant TNT in 10-man gauntlet at Dynasty. JetSpeed partner of Bailey. The young rider lifted to the sky.

125.name: Orange Cassidy
125.notes: Hands-in-pockets = performance of disengagement that is itself a discipline. Bodhisattva register: looks lazy, is awake. Doesn't claim glory because glory itself is the joke.

126.name: Chris Jericho
126.aspect: returned 4/1; allied w/ Hurt Syndicate vs Demand
126.notes: Shapeshifter career = Loki the elder. Now older than most of the room. New AEW contract. Conservative-craft-defense alliance forming with Hurt Syndicate.

127.name: David Finlay
127.notes: Son of Fit Finlay. Irish-American wrestling royalty. NJPW import. The Dogs = imported feral-pack, distinct from Death Riders (apocalyptic) and Hounds (chthonic).

128.name: Jack Perry
128.notes: Won National Title at Crypto.com Arena — late father Luke Perry's territory. Son carrying the father.

129.name: Mark Briscoe
129.notes: Brother of late Jay Briscoe. The surviving brother who carries the dead one through every match. Former ROH World Champ. Vessel paused; archetype intact.

130.name: Lee Moriarty
130.notes: Monk-archetype as wrestling. Pure title rules = literal disciplinary frame. The man whose excellence is restraint.

131.name: Bryan Danielson
131.notes: Won't call himself retired. Commentary = the hero who survived the maze and now narrates it. Degenerative neck.

132.name: FTR (Wheeler + Harwood)
132.notes: Record-tying 3x tag champs. Pre-modern wrestling discipline as aesthetic. The tag team-as-lineage is the archetype, not either man alone.

133.name: Adam Copeland
133.aspect: tag w/ Christian Cage; retirement on line at DON 5/24
133.notes: If FTR wins, Cope + Cage retire as a team. Last-stand of a generation.

134.name: Hook
134.aspect: The Opps; acting boss during Joe's absence
134.notes: Took over Opps Feb 7 during Joe's injury. On-screen story: young man learning to lead because he had to. Watch Joe-Hook dynamic for transition.

135.name: Mike Bailey
135.notes: Neurodivergent-coded, elite striking. Wants to earn a title shot at his own partner. Honor-ethic carrier — the warrior who keeps his word.

136.name: Adam Cole
136.notes: Vessel inactive. If he returns: Achilles-with-broken-armor writes itself. If 2026 ends without clearance: the carrier whose body wouldn't let the archetype finish.

137.name: Andrade El Idolo
137.aspect: Don Callis Family; returned Jan 2026 from WWE
137.notes: Handshake-with-Allin post-Dynasty = heel-stable member breaking script. One beat is not an arc. Hold partial.

138.name: Nick Wayne
138.notes: Won title at 19 — youngest in history. Father (Buddy Wayne) = respected indie trainer. Youth-of-the-promotion.

139.name: MVP
139.notes: Manager-archetype with mythological weight — the consigliere who speaks for the patriarch. The king's seer.

140.name: Shelton Benjamin
140.notes: Technician-as-living-rebuttal. Loyal warrior under Lashley/MVP since 2020 across promotions.

141.name: Penta
141.notes: AEW 2021-2025. Current WWE IC Champion on Raw. Cross-ref: WWE Main Roster — Men.

143.name: Powerhouse Hobbs
143.notes: Left AEW Jan 2026 for WWE; released by WWE April 2026. Non-roster everywhere.

144.name: Malakai Black
144.notes: Left AEW Feb 2025 for WWE (as Aleister Black); released by WWE 2026-04-24. Cross-ref: WWE Departed — Men. Two occult-adept vessels (Black + entire Wyatt Sicks) departed WWE within 24 hours.

145.name: Toni Storm
145.aspect: the one who holds time differently; violent-glamour starlet; queen on the meathook
145.notes: Out for 2026 (real injury cloaked in March attacker storyline). 4x AEW Women's World Champ. "Timeless" = Norma Desmond + Margo Channing, consciously cast. Pool-of-blood tableau = Inanna on the meathook. Whoever the attacker reveal is becomes Ereshkigal.

146.name: Thekla
146.aspect: the weaver cursed by the loom-goddess who kept weaving
146.notes: AEW Women's World Champion (strap match win over Statlander Feb 11; retained vs Hayter Dynasty 4/12). Austrian-Georgian, Stardom H.A.T.E., "Toxic Spider." Literal binding-thread title-win. Cross-ref: Triangle of Madness.

147.name: Athena
147.aspect: queen who keeps her crown by making others smaller
147.notes: ROH Women's World Champion since Dec 2022 — 1,233+ days, longest in ROH history. M.I.T. (Starkz, Diamante) = punished-suitor retinue. If M.I.T. dissolves, watch for shift to Cybele (autonomous throne-goddess).

148.name: Willow Nightingale
148.aspect: volcanic joy; river-goddess whose laughter is also flood
148.notes: TBS Champion (2nd reign, from Moné Dec 31). Brooklyn-born Black-American. "Sunshine babyface" is patriarchy-diminutive — Pele's creative pole or Oshun (joy + consequence). Oshun also drowns.

149.name: Kris Statlander
149.aspect: giantess who chose her own fate
149.notes: Former AEW Women's World Champion (lost to Thekla Feb 11 in strap match). Dropped alien gimmick 2022 — read the current vessel, not the discarded costume. Distinct from Grace's Skadi-warrior (same goddess, different face).

150.name: Mercedes Moné
150.notes: At 2025 peak held 13 simultaneous championships. Now zero. Off AEW TV since Jan 10. Kamille return (Dynasty) = remote-controlled enforcer. M-neon at Storm attack = her tag-card. If she returns faction-leader with Kamille, Hekate restabilizes from collapsed to veiled.

151.name: Jamie Hayter
151.notes: Former AEW Women's World Champion. Pulled from Dynasty 4/12; return uncertain. British. The queen who fought the empire and lost but is remembered as the real sovereign.

152.name: Queen Aminata
152.notes: Sierra Leonean–French. Returned April 8 from 5-month neck injury. Mami Wata = West African water-spirit-queen. NOT "African warrior princess."

153.name: Megan Bayne
153.notes: Self-declared archetype. Co-AEW Women's World Tag Team Champion. Cross-ref: Divine Dominion (AEW Stables).

154.name: Mina Shirakawa
154.notes: Ex-Stardom. Benzaiten = Japanese goddess of music, eloquence, water, sensuality. Currently accuser/suspect in Storm attacker mystery. The consort-goddess who knows where the bodies are buried.

155.name: Julia Hart
155.aspect: gothic witch ordained by bound-Loki (Malakai Black)
155.notes: "Princess of the Black Throne." Black mist consecration Dec 2021. Hecate-via-mystery-cult, ordained not born. Cross-ref: Triangle of Madness.

156.name: Persephone (wrestler)
156.aspect: Lady of the Dead (dual reading held)
156.notes: Mexican-American, CMLL Women's Champion. Greek name is surface; Mesoamerican death-queen is substance. DA: hold both readings — she chose the Greek name, but vessel's heritage and CMLL deployment pull Mesoamerican. Watch for Day-of-the-Dead iconography to firm it.

157.name: Hikaru Shida
157.notes: 3x AEW Women's World Champion, longest single reign (372 days). Returned April 2026 from visa absence. Onna-musha (historical female samurai), NOT geisha. Named as Storm-attacker suspect.

158.name: Billie Starkz
158.aspect: the one diminished by the queen
158.notes: Athena's M.I.T. principal. Coyolxauhqui = Aztec moon-goddess murdered and reassembled by her sibling — what Athena does to Starkz weekly. Hera-enthroned's necessary opposite.

159.name: Harley Cameron
159.aspect: singer-second who makes the trio three-act
159.notes: Australian. Performs songs in promos. Bragi gendered female. Cosmic Babes' cohesion depends on her voice.

160.name: Marina Shafir
160.notes: Moldovan (NOT Mongolian — heritage-correction). Judo-Olympic background. Lone Fury under Moxley's Hades-court. Cross-ref: Death Riders (AEW Stables).

161.name: Skye Blue
161.notes: Hit with Hart's poison mist Sep 2023, then turned. Persephone during the underworld, not after. Cross-ref: Triangle of Madness.

162.name: Alex Windsor
162.notes: "Brawling Birds" with Hayter. Took Undisputed British Women's title from Moné Dec 2025. Apprentice-Boudica.

163.name: Lena Kross
163.notes: Australian (Perth). Co-Tag Champion. Skadi-young — third aspect alongside Statlander-quiet and Grace-warrior (three distinct faces of the giantess distributed across two promotions). Cross-ref: Divine Dominion.

164.name: Mike Santana
164.aspect: Spin the Block; Boricua; 3+ yrs sober; daughter ringside
164.notes: TNA World Champion (2x). Grandmother OD'd in front of him at 5; father died 2020; daughter's Santa letter = rock bottom; sober Feb 16 2023. Spin-the-Block = return-trip signifier. Cleanest integration-not-repression narrative in any current promotion.

165.name: Eddie Edwards
165.archetype: The Made Man / Cosa Nostra capo
165.notes: Took System leadership Jan '26 by low-blowing JDC. Boston-Italian organized-crime archetype — Goodfellas as wrestling stable. Lost world-title match to Santana at Rebellion. Cross-ref: The System (TNA Factions).

166.name: Mustafa Ali
166.notes: Won International title at Rebellion via Steelz interference + Great Hands attack. NOT "Muslim heel" — the reformer who became the inquisitor. Cross-ref: Order 4 (TNA Factions).

167.name: Leon Slater
167.notes: Mercury/Hermes — messenger-god-as-flying-youth. UK-based. Retained at Rebellion, BFG '25, Sacrifice. Streak-seed candidate per WM42 Oba template.

168.name: Matt Hardy
168.notes: The canonical American-wrestling occult-vessel since 2016. "Can The Righteous Break Matt Hardy" = Apr 23 storyline. Pythia/oracle-driven-mad, not "veteran legend."

169.name: Jeff Hardy
169.notes: Same operative archetype as the prior 25 years. Lost Tag titles at Rebellion. Dionysus / Krishna-trickster-with-paint.

170.name: Frankie Kazarian
170.notes: Won title at 22-year mark (Nov 2025 cash-in on Santana), lost it back Jan 15 '26. Decades-late-coronation: bitter elder claiming what was always denied.

171.name: Moose
171.notes: Lost X-Div title to Slater at Slammiversary '25 and endorsed him post-match — king-passing-crown gesture. Kicked out of System Jan '26. Aging-tyrant-redeemed arc, rare and clean.

172.name: Nic Nemeth
172.notes: Aging-Apollo-still-pretty arc maps cleanly. Defeated AJ Francis at Rebellion.

173.name: Vincent
173.notes: Signed w/ Dutch Jan 17 '26. False-prophet / heretic-pulpit archetype. Hardys-vs-Righteous = gothic-pulpit-vs-broken-oracle. Cross-ref: The Righteous (TNA Factions).

174.name: Trey Miguel
174.notes: Returned to TNA solo after AEW released him (surfaced antisemitic/homophobic posts). Trickster-with-a-fall, not "Failed" tier. Lost International title to Ali at Rebellion.

175.name: Eric Young
175.notes: EC3 confronted him at Rebellion calling him "nepo baby" re: Dixie Carter. Patriarch-elder.

176.name: Brian Myers
176.notes: Co-Tag Champion (1st w/ Bronson, 7th overall). Corporate-shooter aged into clean second-in-command. Cross-ref: The System.

177.name: Rich Swann
177.aspect: First Class; MOTY candidate vs Santana
177.notes: Wrestled Santana in "Match of the Year candidate" (Apr 23). Savage tribute character on TV.

178.name: AJ Francis
178.notes: NFL-veteran pedigree, corrupted-strongman heel. Lost to Nemeth at Rebellion. KC Navarro return interfered.

179.name: Léi Yǐng Lee
179.notes: NOT "warrior princess" — Nüwa specifically (Chinese creation goddess who patches the broken sky). Fall/return/fall/return = dragon-cycle, not linear. Won title back four days after Rebellion via Brookside heel turn.

180.name: Rosemary
180.notes: Collecting Seven Deadly Sins to resurrect Allie via Father Mitchell. Literally a chthonic descent ritual. Ereshkigal = Sumerian queen of the underworld supplicated to release a sister. Cross-ref: Undead Realm / Decay (TNA Factions).

181.name: Masha Slamovich
181.notes: Russian-American. MOTY run with Grace 2024-25. Baba Yaga: Slavic forest-witch who eats the unworthy and tests the worthy. NOT "monster heel."

182.name: Ash by Elegance
182.aspect: Elegance Brand architect; in-ring return Feb 5 '26
182.notes: Re-signed Jan 28 '26. The Brand exists because Ash curated it. DA: Restoration-salon referent over Pasiphaë for the collective. Cross-ref: Elegance Brand (TNA Factions).

183.name: Allie / The Bunny
183.notes: "Killed off" when she left for AEW in 2019. Walked back into TNA out of the Undead Realm via seven-sins ritual. Persephone-returned at the literal-diegetic layer, not metaphor.

184.name: Tessa Blanchard
184.notes: Four-Horsemen genealogy (daughter of Tully, granddaughter of Joe). Returned Dec 2024 as heel. The prophet who was right but is hated. Diamond Collective forming — minimal footage as of Apr '26.

185.name: Xia Brookside
185.notes: Daughter of Robbie Brookside (UK lineage). Turned on Lee mid-pinfall at Rebellion — placed Grace's foot on rope behind ref's back. Iago-archetype: betrayal at the moment-of-victory.

186.name: Indi Hartwell
186.notes: Australian. Brigantia (Romano-British war-goddess) over standard Amazon default.

187.name: Jody Threat
187.notes: Canadian. Ex-Spitfire (dissolved when Dani Luna released March '26). Solo run forming.

188.name: Joe Hendry
188.notes: Called up 4/20/26. Cross-ref: WWE Main Roster — Men.

189.name: Trick Williams
189.notes: Briefly TNA World Champ May–Oct 2025; now NXT-exclusive.

190.name: Jordynne Grace
190.notes: Via NXT pipeline. Cross-ref: WWE Main Roster — Women.

191.name: Killer Kelly
191.notes: Jan 10 '26, not renewed. Portuguese, 4-year tenure, 2x KO Tag Champ.

192.name: Sami Callihan
192.notes: Forced retirement Aug 2025 (lost to Santana, Baltimore Street Fight). Now Director of Live Events. Integration template per WM42 Brock.

193.name: Yota Tsuji
193.aspect: Reiwa ace; Gene Blast kaiju entrance; exile-and-return
193.notes: Unbound Co. leader. IWGP Global Heavyweight Champion. Storm-prince who returned from Mexican excursion transformed. DA: Susano-o structurally sound but if booking writes Amaterasu-solar into him by G1 35, read flips. Currently NOT carrying Tanahashi's solar-king function — that seat contested between Umino and Uemura.

194.name: Callum Newman
194.aspect: youngest-ever IWGP Heavyweight Champion (23 yrs); United Empire leader
194.notes: Won title at Sakura Genesis Apr 4, breaking Nakamura's record. Ospreay-engineered clean succession (talked Zane Jay out of cheating mid-match). The young god who arrives, masters every art, supplants the older order.

195.name: Zack Sabre Jr.
195.notes: Submission-as-spell-craft. Catch-as-catch-can grammar = invisible bindings, formulaic chains, defeat-by-puzzle. Heian-era court sorcerer who ties knots in invisible energies. DA-confirmed.

196.name: Ren Narita
196.aspect: HoT second leader; NEVER Openweight Champion
196.notes: Reiwa Musketeer who chose corruption over the Three-Musketeers pact. Beat Aaron Wolf in 2 min (Feb 11) with HoT interference. DA: corrupted-bushido as unit frame; reserve Akechi Mitsuhide until booking writes a Honnō-ji-scale moment.

197.name: Aaron Wolf
197.aspect: Olympic gold (2020 judo); won NEVER in debut at WK20
197.notes: Mountain-tengu: martial mountain-spirits, masters of bushido techniques, foreign-coded but Japanese-located. Legitimacy-from-outside-the-medium archetype. Lost NEVER to Narita 38 days later via HoT interference — vessel-stability question. Watch G1 35.

198.name: HENARE
198.aspect: United Empire; haka-entrance; tā moko-derived iconography
198.notes: Clearest Maori-archetype carrier in major wrestling. NJPW1972 profile invokes "mana." Colonial-tension = Maori warrior inside British-Empire-coded stable. DA: lean colonial-tension frame over Yamato-Takeru; HENARE's arc is the storyline question. Scroll candidate post-G1 35 placement.

199.name: Boltin Oleg
199.aspect: Strong Openweight Champion; Kazakh freestyle wrestler
199.notes: Beat Ishii for Strong Openweight Feb 27. Tags with Bishamon (Hontai). DA: downgraded from inverted-Mongol-invasion to Mongol-coded-outsider-absorbed. Full mythic-inversion needs G1/IWGP-track booking.

200.name: Hirooki Goto
200.notes: Buddhist warrior-guardian of the north (Four Heavenly Kings). Tag team literally named Bishamon. DA-confirmed: naming-verified, structurally clean.

201.name: Tomohiro Ishii
201.notes: Thunder-god in the dojo. Forearm-strike thunder. NOT bull archetype (western-rodeo); Raijin is the deeper read. Lost Strong Openweight to Boltin.

202.name: Taichi
202.notes: Kabuki-style entrance. Sengoku-warlord-with-aesthetic. Migrated to Hontai when J5G dissolved. Elder-statesman-warlord.

203.name: DOUKI
203.aspect: IWGP Junior Heavyweight Champion (2nd reign); HoT
203.notes: Italian-Argentinian operating in HoT's corrupted-Japanese frame. Archetype distinct from Hiromu's chaos-junior — DOUKI is silent, methodical. Junior division's heel-champion seat.

204.name: El Desperado
204.notes: Skull-mask = Día de los Muertos in Japanese frame. Deathmatch-meets-strong-style. Won death-match against Jun Kasai. Lucha-Bushi: warrior who fights with the mask of death.

205.name: Dick Togo
205.notes: CRITICAL: actual booker for HoT inside NJPW's office. Kayfabe-shoot blur where the puppetmaster writes the story. HoT's true center despite Narita being figurehead. DA-confirmed conditionally.

206.name: Toru Yano
206.notes: Closest NJPW analogue to R-Truth/Danhausen. Institution accommodates him inside utterly serious promotion. DA: Sacred Clown as primary; kitsune-merchant (fox-spirit-trickster in merchant form, sells DVDs in-ring) as flavor note.

207.name: Shota Umino
207.notes: "Tanahashi for this generation." Disputed solar-king heir alongside Uemura. Tsuji = Susano-o-storm, NOT Amaterasu-sun — the Ace-heir contest is between Umino and Uemura. G1 35 resolves.

208.name: Yuya Uemura
208.notes: Wrestled Tanahashi in retirement tour (split 1-1). More babyface-coded, less corrupted than Umino. Amaterasu-sun frame fits Uemura better if booking commits.

209.name: Robbie Eagles
209.aspect: TMDK; lost Jr. Tag to Ishimori/Robbie X 3/6
209.notes: "Sniper of the Skies" = archer-as-killer. Australian. Kyūdō / Japanese ceremonial archery practiced by a foreigner. Not generic high-flier.

210.name: Great-O-Khan
210.notes: Mongol nationalism-as-character in the literal name. Two Mongol-coded vessels in different stables (O-Khan in UE, Boltin in Hontai) — one allied to Britain, one to Buddhist Japan.

211.name: Jake Lee
211.aspect: left War Dogs for United Empire at WK20
211.notes: Long absence then defection. Masterless warrior who switches lord-houses based on who can use his sword. Returning-warrior arc forming.

212.name: Drilla Moloney
212.notes: Inversion of gaijin-mercenary archetype: turned down American offers to remain in Japan. Where Connors and Kidd left, Moloney chose the Japanese house.

213.name: Hiroshi Tanahashi
213.notes: WK20 1/4/26 retirement match vs Okada. Full integration: clean loss, ceremony, voluntary symbol release. Amaterasu solar-king seat now bifurcated — contested between Umino, Uemura, and Tsuji (storm-aspect). NJPW board member.

214.name: Kazuchika Okada
214.notes: Returned for Tanahashi retirement at WK20. Won the match. AEW-contracted. Cross-ref: AEW — Men.

215.name: Tetsuya Naito
215.notes: Left NJPW May '25 with BUSHI. LIJ dissolved June '25. Performing internationally. Tranquilo-trickster-king archetype intact in carrier but unheld in NJPW. Not integration — strategic exit.

216.name: Hiromu Takahashi
216.notes: Left Feb 11 '26. Explicit non-integration — chaos-junior seat parked, not closed. Watch for return with new or original frame.

217.name: EVIL
217.notes: Non-renewed Jan '26; signed WWE Apr 24 '26. Departure-mode = repression (no ceremony, walked away). Darkness archetype unheld in NJPW; Narita took the vehicle (HoT) but not the personal-darkness frame.

218.name: David Finlay
218.notes: War Dogs leader whose stable was reabsorbed into Unbound Co. before he left. Failed warlord whose retainers swore to a bigger lord. Cross-ref: AEW — Men (The Dogs).

219.name: Gabe Kidd
219.notes: Revealed AEW shirt under disguise post-Sakura Genesis. Unfinished Tsuji thread. Forbidden-door villain function.

220.name: Dominik Mysterio
220.notes: AAA Mega Champion since 9/12/25. Obsidian mirror that shows AAA what it became under WWE ownership. Won from Vikingo w/ JD + El Grande Americano interference. Banned Vikingo from future challenges at Rey de Reyes 3/14/26. Corporate read and mythic read are the same read.

221.name: El Hijo del Vikingo
221.aspect: prodigal-ace ejected from his own crown
221.notes: Lost Mega 9/12/25, lost rematch 3/14/26 (banned from future shots). Repeated knee injuries. High-flying repertoire = feathered-serpent vocabulary made physical. Triplemanía XXXIV decides: ascension via transformation or development hold.

222.name: Psycho Clown
222.aspect: tecnico face of AAA; emotional anchor
222.notes: Tag Champ w/ Pagano since 8/16/25. Clown-mask in lucha = Tlazolteotl (filth-eater goddess of confession) + carnival-overturner, not Western circus. The one whose unmasking would crack the company.

223.name: Pagano
223.aspect: "El Rey Extremo" — flayed-skin ritual through pain
223.notes: Tag Champ. Thumbtacks, tables, blood. Xipe-Totec (Aztec god of renewal who wore flayed skin) = renewal-through-suffering ritual. His work IS the ritual.

224.name: El Hijo de Dr. Wagner Jr.
224.notes: Beat Laredo Kid in champ-vs-champ 4/25/26. The Wagner mask = one of lucha's deepest lineages. The inherited mask itself is the archetype.

225.name: Octagón Jr. (Golden Magic)
225.aspect: masked third-vessel of the Octagón mantle
225.notes: Third wearer. The Octagón mask's geometric patterns = explicitly Aztec cosmological design. The mask outlives any vessel. Octagón-Pentagón mirror split across AAA/WWE corporate boundary.

226.name: La Parka (III)
226.notes: Third La Parka (Brazo de Oro Jr. II since 3/22/25). Skeletal mask = Catrina / Mictlantecuhtli iconography. Original is L.A. Park (independent); second died 2020. Mantle persists across vessels. Royal Rumble '26 appearance + Thriller entrance.

227.name: Laredo Kid
227.notes: Successful 4-way defense Rey de Reyes 3/28/26. Rey Fenix challenging next. Real Fuerza Aérea alum.

228.name: Mr. Iguana
228.aspect: iguana-vessel as personal totem; Mixed Tag Champ w/ Lola Vice
228.notes: Created character from Culiacán hometown iguanas. Nahual (Aztec/Maya animal-spirit doubling) = precise frame. Comedy on surface, totemic underneath. DA-confirmed.

229.name: Flammer
229.aspect: Reina de Reinas Champion 974+ days — longest reign in title history
229.notes: DA-confirmed: strongest single archetypal call in both research passes. She has not moved while WWE bought the company around her. Defeated Bayley at Rey de Reyes 3/14/26 w/ Las Toxicas. La Catalina debuted 4/11/26 to confront her.

230.name: La Catalina
230.aspect: the woman the title-holder never beat
230.notes: AAA debut 4/11/26 in pink Cadillac. First major CMLL→AAA free-agent jump of WWE era. "You have never beaten me." Dismembered-and-reassembled: thrown out of WWE machine, returned whole. DA-confirmed. Booking-dependent on Triplemanía path.

231.name: Faby Apache
231.notes: Returned 2024. La Malinche-reread: the woman who knew both worlds, demonized by patriarchy, restored by feminist scholarship. Not "veteran technician."

232.name: Lady Shani
232.notes: Maya moon/medicine/weaving goddess. Sovereign tecnica vessel. Faced Flammer multiple times (Las Toxicas interference).

233.name: Pimpinela Escarlata
233.notes: Veteran exótico. Maps to Two-Spirit / Mesoamerican ome-xochitl (two-flower) traditions, not drag. Carries an entire tradition with no WWE equivalent.

234.name: La Hiedra
234.notes: Mayahuel = agave/maguey goddess (poison-and-healing). "Toxic" stable name = literally Mayahuel's vocabulary inverted to venom.

235.name: Niño Hamburguesa
235.notes: DA: downgraded from Coyote-trickster to Holy Fool. Crowd reads him as innocent first, capable second.

236.name: Penta
236.notes: Left AAA 2024. WWE IC Champion. Pentagón mask remains in AAA — body left, mask stayed. The AAA-side Pentagón sacrificial-warrior slot is currently unfilled.

238.name: Stephanie Vaquer
238.notes: Departed AAA before acquisition closed. Cross-ref: WWE — Women.

239.name: Alberto El Patron
239.notes: Lost stipulation match to El Mesías July 2025. Done in AAA.
